text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of Germany, I visited there long 
ago with my parents on a gem trading trip♪ 
I believe it was in a place known as the 
city of gemstones.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Idar-Oberstein—was it? I visited there 
once with my father as well."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
They bought me a feather keychain with a 
tiny gem on it... It's still my treasure 
even now.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: A feather motif with a little jewel...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Um, by any chance, are these the keychains 
where your wish comes true if you get 
both?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huh...!? Y-Yes, that's right, but why—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I bought the same thing with my allowance! 
I heard there were only two made in the 
entire world, so... what an amazing 
coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. If you'd like, would you be 
willing to accept my keychain?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Please, go ahead and make your wish come 
true. It would bring me great happiness as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the sentiment, but if we do 
that—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...How about we try searching for a wish 
that both of you want to grant?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Even if our tastes and preferences differ, 
if we list them out in detail and examine 
them carefully, I am certain we will find 
it.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu, I see. What a wonderful 
suggestion. Let's definitely do that♪"
